newsitem.title: INDIA: India quake caused $37 million in property damage.
newsitem.headline: India quake caused $37 million in property damage.

text.p: An earthquake that killed dozens of people in India last week destroyed 8,000 houses and damaged 1.31 billion rupees ($37 million) worth of property, a state government minister said on Sunday.

The Press Trust of India quoted R.P. Shukla, legislative affairs minister in the central state of Madhya Pradesh, as saying another 12,000 homes were partially damaged in Thursday's pre-dawn tremor, which measured 6.0 on the Richter scale.
At least 38 people were killed and about 1,000 injured when the earthquake struck Jabalpur city and the surrounding region in Madhya Pradesh state.

Shukla said the state government was seeking 710 million rupees in federal aid, of which 100 million had already been received. The Madhya Pradesh government had announced it would pay 100,000 rupees to the families of the deceased. ($1 = 35.7 rupees)
